adaptation_goal: Choose the source/edition that best supports the intended three-minute cinematic adaptation after comparing textual, creative, provenance and rights implications.

candidates.label: 1818 edition
strengths: original 1818 publication text represented by the Project Gutenberg transcription
useful for first-edition wording and early conception
risks_or_questions: must be compared deliberately against later author-revised text
visual references from 1831 must not be mistaken for proof of 1818 textual choices

candidates.label: 1831 edition
strengths: naturally aligns with some surviving 1831 visual references used in look development
risks_or_questions: revision changes may alter adaptation emphasis
visual-reference alignment alone is not a reason to choose the text

replacement_rule: If a new or existing candidate proves materially better for the adaptation goal, update the contract, record why, and re-evaluate every dependent source obligation and Item. Final lock is for reproducibility, not immutability.
